title: Modulo Self-Reliance Officer
tagline: Arrives in a green Vue hoodie, sticker-plastered laptop in tow, and does the remainder math without is-odd's help.

title: Keeper of the Grudge Against node-cron
tagline: Tall tote-bag carrier who has a deeply personal cron job to settle, and a debugger already attached.

title: Date Picker Abolitionist
tagline: Sketches the replacement on a napkin, a coaster, and possibly your sleeve before the first talk even starts.

title: Survivor of the left-pad Incident
tagline: Was there when left-pad vanished, and now wears 'it works on my cluster' like a veteran's medal.

title: Warden of the Mystery Lockfile
tagline: Arrives in a red blazer with a 'We're hiring' sign, and would still like someone to explain those 400 transitive deps.

title: Kofola-Fueled Force-Fixer
tagline: Ran npm audit fix --force once and is still meeting the strangers it installed, somewhere near the stage.

title: Chief Rate-Limit Apologist
tagline: Jokes about deleting express-rate-limit, then immediately begs the whole room to install it before the Friday deploy.

title: Bailiff of the Zero-Crown Sofa
tagline: Has seen a sofa listed at 0 CZK in production and now checks every price formatter like a bouncer checks IDs.

title: Double-Click Interrogator
tagline: Marta greets every shiny new button with one calm question: but what if the user clicks twice?

title: Sticker Dispenser With a Stage Scar
tagline: Diego still hears a faint .env echo from that one live demo, and hands out stickers anyway to change the subject.

title: Timezone Survivor Who Knits
tagline: Has untangled more UTC offsets than yarn, and only one of the two has ever behaved during a conference talk.

title: Custodian of Two Dying Phones
tagline: Arrives with two phones at 3% battery and still distrusts any postinstall script that phones home more than they do.

title: Front-Row Exorcist of AngularJS 1.x
tagline: Spots the green scarf, grabs the front row, and quietly removes angular 1.x from every repo they own.

title: Backlog Lighthouse Keeper
tagline: Would unpublish their own package to close the issues, then reopen one just to answer it over a Guinness.

title: Neon Alien Backpack Cartographer
tagline: Wants lodash deleted from the internet because tree-shaking took everything else with it, and still says it calmly.
